userOutcome: Users can record income, expenses, and transfers with full double-entry integrity — simple transaction form in UI, balanced journal entries underneath
scopeSummary: Accounting context phase 2 (internal/accounting/domain/entry/): JournalEntry aggregate root with JournalLine child entities, EntryStatus value object. Invariant: SUM(lines.amount) = 0. Factory methods (NewExpense/NewTransfer/NewIncome). Void() via reversal. CQRS: RecordTransaction command + AccountLedger/TrialBalance queries. Event-driven: JournalEntryRecorded (sync: balance projection, async: outbox for budget checks). PostgreSQL outbox. Dual API. Next.js transaction form + ledger view.
readinessReason: Research provides complete schema, JournalEntry aggregate with factories, repository interfaces, CQRS handlers, event catalog, and PostgreSQL patterns.
handoffSummary: Implement internal/accounting/domain/entry: JournalEntry aggregate with Lines, Validate(), factories, Void(). CQRS command/query handlers. PostgreSQL repos with constraint triggers, materialized views. Event-driven balance projection + outbox. Dual API. Categories table. Next.js transaction form + ledger view.
